title: Asserts with values
description:
Write an assert that prints the values on both sides of a comparison.

```
ASSERT_EQ(score, 100) failed: score is 90, expected 100 (main.cpp:12)
ASSERT_LT(index, size) failed: index is 5, size is 5
```
hints: Passing the values to a function evaluates them once; the macro only adds the text and the position (lesson 8.03).
requirements: Macros `ASSERT_EQ(a, b)` and `ASSERT_LT(a, b)` that print the expressions and their values.
They evaluate each argument only once.
Stop in the debugger (`__debugbreak` on MSVC) or `std::abort` elsewhere.
stretch: Print the call stack too with `std::stacktrace` (C++23) where it is available.
